1	// TypeScript 7.1's checker as a test oracle for Caliper's prop types (docs/parity.md). Test-only: the opt-in semantic
2	// backend is a separate, experimental feature.
3	//
4	// For one corpus, finds components the way react-docgen-typescript does (an exported function whose only or `props`
5	// parameter is the props type), reads each prop's type from the checker, and compares it structurally with the prop
6	// Caliper's canonical JSON reports for the same component (src/oracle-compare.ts). Each shared prop gets one verdict:
7	//
8	//   identical          both sides describe the same type
9	//   spelled            the same type, Caliper by name where the checker expands it, or the reverse
10	//   less precise       Caliper's type is looser or unevaluated (an opaque type, `string` for a literal union, a name
11	//                      left unexpanded, a lost optional or rest parameter, a missing field)
12	//   wrong              Caliper's type describes something else
13	//   checker any/error  the checker itself has no type (an unresolved import, `any`, or `unknown` where Caliper has one)
14	//
15	// Checker types are normalized once per type id and verdicts made once per (Caliper prop, checker type), so Chakra's
16	// ~470,000 props cost a few thousand distinct comparisons.
17	//
18	import { readdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
19	import { join, relative } from 'node:path'
20	import { API, SignatureKind, SymbolFlags } from 'typescript-beta/sync'
21	import { checkerNormalizer } from './oracle-checker.ts'
22	import { caliperNorm, compare, VERDICTS, type Norm, type Verdict } from './oracle-compare.ts'
23	
24	const KEYS = ['root', 'src', 'tsconfig', 'caliper', 'out', 'files', 'dump', 'rows', 'missing'] as const
25	const args: Partial<Record<(typeof KEYS)[number], string>> = {}
26	for (let i = 2; i < process.argv.length; i += 2) {
27	  args[process.argv[i].replace(/^--/, '') as (typeof KEYS)[number]] = process.argv[i + 1]
28	}
29	if (!args.root || !args.src || !args.tsconfig || !args.caliper || !args.out) {
30	  console.error('usage: tsx src/oracle.ts --root DIR --src DIR --tsconfig FILE --caliper FILE --out FILE')
31	  process.exit(2)
32	}
33	const root = realpathSync(args.root)
34	
35	function walk(dir: string): string[] {
36	  const out: string[] = []
37	  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
38	    if (entry.name === 'node_modules') continue
39	    const path = join(dir, entry.name)
40	    if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(path))
41	    else out.push(path)
42	  }
43	  return out
44	}
45	
46	const files: string[] = args.files
47	  ? readFileSync(args.files, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean)
48	  : walk(realpathSync(args.src))
49	      .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.tsx'))
50	      .toSorted()
51	
52	const api = new API({ cwd: root })
53	const programStart = performance.now()
54	// The same program react-docgen-typescript parses in scripts/weekly.py: the component files, with the tsconfig it
55	// uses. The options go through `parseConfigFile` because the 7.1 beta's server panics on string-valued enum options
56	// passed to `createProgram` directly.
57	const { options } = api.parseConfigFile(args.tsconfig)
58	const program = api.createProgram(files, options)
59	const { checker } = program.getProject()
60	const programMs = performance.now() - programStart
61	const checkerNorm = checkerNormalizer(checker)
62	
63	// ─── Components ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
64	
65	const normComponent = (name: string) =>
66	  (
67	    name
68	      .replace(/ \(.*\)$/, '')
69	      .split('/')
70	      .at(-1) ?? ''
71	  )
72	    .split('.')
73	    .at(-1)!
74	    .replaceAll(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '')
75	const rel = (path: string) => relative(root, realpathSync(path))
76	const pathKey = (path: string) =>
77	  process.platform === 'darwin' || process.platform === 'win32' ? path.toLowerCase() : path
78	
79	const caliper = JSON.parse(readFileSync(args.caliper, 'utf8'))
80	const caliperByFile = new Map<string, { name: string; key: string; component: any }[]>()
81	for (const [componentKey, component] of Object.entries<any>(caliper.components)) {
82	  // Schema 2 lists a component's prop set ids, each a map of prop name to prop id; this reads one map of both.
83	  if (Array.isArray(component.props)) {
84	    component.props = Object.assign({}, ...component.props.map((id: string) => caliper.propSets[id]))
85	  }
86	  const key = rel(component.filePath)
87	  const list = caliperByFile.get(key) ?? []
88	  list.push({ name: normComponent(component.displayName), key: componentKey, component })
89	  caliperByFile.set(key, list)
90	}
91	
92	/** The props type of a component export, the way react-docgen-typescript finds it. */
93	function propsTypeOf(exported: any): any | undefined {
94	  const symbol = exported.flags & SymbolFlags.Alias ? checker.getAliasedSymbol(exported) : exported
95	  const type = checker.getTypeOfSymbol(symbol)
96	  for (const sig of checker.getSignaturesOfType(type, SignatureKind.Call)) {
97	    const params = sig.getParameters()
98	    if (params.length === 1 || params[0]?.name === 'props') return checker.getTypeOfSymbol(params[0])
99	  }
100	  for (const sig of checker.getSignaturesOfType(type, SignatureKind.Construct)) {
101	    if (sig.getParameters().length > 1) continue
102	    const props = checker.getPropertyOfType(sig.getReturnType(), 'props')
103	    if (props) return checker.getTypeOfSymbol(props)
104	  }
105	  return undefined
106	}
107	
108	/** A default export is named by what it exports: the aliased declaration, or the function or class itself. */
109	function exportName(exported: any): string {
110	  if (exported.name !== 'default') return exported.name
111	  if (exported.flags & SymbolFlags.Alias) return checker.getAliasedSymbol(exported).name
112	  return checker.getTypeOfSymbol(exported).getSymbol()?.name ?? 'default'
113	}
114	
115	interface Example {
116	  component: string
117	  prop: string
118	  caliper: unknown
119	  checker: string
120	  normalized: object
121	}
122	const counts = Object.fromEntries(VERDICTS.map((v) => [v, 0])) as Record<Verdict, number>
123	const examples = Object.fromEntries(VERDICTS.map((v) => [v, [] as Example[]])) as Record<Verdict, Example[]>
124	const verdictCache = new Map<string, Verdict>()
125	const rows: [string, string, Verdict | 'missing' | 'collapsed'][] = []
126	const missingDetails: { key: string; prop: string; verdict: 'missing' | 'collapsed'; declarations: string[] }[] = []
127	const dumped: {
128	  key: string
129	  file: string
130	  component: string
131	  prop: string
132	  verdict: Verdict
133	  caliper: unknown
134	  checker: string
135	}[] = []
136	const totals = {
137	  componentsChecker: 0,
138	  componentsMatched: 0,
139	  propsChecker: 0,
140	  propsShared: 0,
141	  propsMissing: 0,
142	  propsCollapsed: 0,
143	  failedExports: 0,
144	  ambiguousExports: 0,
145	}
146	
147	/** The verdict for one prop, made once per (Caliper prop, checker type). */
148	function judge({
149	  component,
150	  prop,
151	  caliperId,
152	  type,
153	}: {
154	  component: string
155	  prop: string
156	  caliperId: string
157	  type: any
158	}) {
159	  const key = `${caliperId}:${type.id}`
160	  const cached = verdictCache.get(key)
161	  if (cached !== undefined) return cached
162	  const c: Norm = caliperNorm(caliper.props[caliperId].type)
163	  const k: Norm = checkerNorm(type)
164	  const verdict = compare(c, k)
165	  verdictCache.set(key, verdict)
166	  if (examples[verdict].length < 20) {
167	    const checkerText = checker.typeToString(type)
168	    examples[verdict].push({
169	      component,
170	      prop,
171	      caliper: caliper.props[caliperId].type,
172	      checker: checkerText,
173	      normalized: { caliper: c, checker: k },
174	    })
175	  }
176	  return verdict
177	}
178	
179	/** Every prop of one exported component the checker finds, against Caliper's component of the same name. */
180	function visitExport(exported: any, candidates: { name: string; key: string; component: any }[], file: string): void {
181	  let propsType
182	  try {
183	    propsType = propsTypeOf(exported)
184	  } catch {
185	    totals.failedExports++
186	    return
187	  }
188	  if (!propsType) return
189	  const props = checker.getPropertiesOfType(propsType)
190	  if (props.length === 0) return
191	  totals.componentsChecker++
192	  const name = exportName(exported)
193	  // React's DOM attributes are one inherited layer; ref and key are deliberately absent from Caliper's output.
194	  const own = props.filter(
195	    (p: any) =>
196	      p.name !== 'ref' &&
197	      p.name !== 'key' &&
198	      !p.declarations?.some((d: any) => String(d.path).includes('/@types/react/')),
199	  )
200	  totals.propsChecker += own.length
201	  const matches = candidates.filter((c) => c.name === normComponent(name))
202	  if (matches.length > 1) {
203	    totals.ambiguousExports++
204	    return
205	  }
206	  const [match] = matches
207	  if (!match) return
208	  totals.componentsMatched++
209	  const shared = own.filter((p: any) => p.name in match.component.props)
210	  const layerFiles = new Set(
211	    (match.component.inheritance ?? [])
212	      .filter((layer: any) => layer.totalProps > 30)
213	      .map((layer: any) => pathKey(String(layer.fileName))),
214	  )
215	  const absent = own.filter((p: any) => !(p.name in match.component.props))
216	  const collapsed: any[] = []
217	  const missing: any[] = []
218	  for (const p of absent) {
219	    if (p.declarations?.some((d: any) => layerFiles.has(pathKey(String(d.path))))) collapsed.push(p)
220	    else missing.push(p)
221	  }
222	  totals.propsMissing += missing.length
223	  totals.propsCollapsed += collapsed.length
224	  if (args.rows) rows.push(...missing.map((p: any) => [match.key, p.name, 'missing'] as [string, string, 'missing']))
225	  if (args.rows)
226	    rows.push(...collapsed.map((p: any) => [match.key, p.name, 'collapsed'] as [string, string, 'collapsed']))
227	  if (args.missing) {
228	    for (const [verdict, absentProps] of [
229	      ['missing', missing],
230	      ['collapsed', collapsed],
231	    ] as const) {
232	      for (const p of absentProps) {
233	        missingDetails.push({
234	          key: match.key,
235	          prop: p.name,
236	          verdict,
237	          declarations: p.declarations?.map((d: any) => String(d.path)) ?? [],
238	        })
239	      }
240	    }
241	  }
242	  if (shared.length === 0) return
243	  const types = checker.getTypeOfSymbol(shared)
244	  for (const [i, p] of shared.entries()) {
245	    totals.propsShared++
246	    const caliperId = match.component.props[p.name]
247	    const verdict = judge({ component: name, prop: p.name, caliperId, type: types[i] })
248	    counts[verdict]++
249	    if (args.rows) rows.push([match.key, p.name, verdict])
250	    if (args.dump && (verdict === 'wrong' || verdict === 'less precise')) {
251	      dumped.push({
252	        key: match.key,
253	        file: rel(file),
254	        component: name,
255	        prop: p.name,
256	        verdict,
257	        caliper: caliper.props[caliperId].type,
258	        checker: checker.typeToString(types[i]),
259	      })
260	    }
261	  }
262	}
263	
264	const start = performance.now()
265	for (const file of files) {
266	  const moduleSymbol = checker.getSymbolOfSourceFile(file)
267	  if (!moduleSymbol) continue
268	  const candidates = caliperByFile.get(rel(file)) ?? []
269	  for (const exported of checker.getExportsOfModule(moduleSymbol)) visitExport(exported, candidates, file)
270	}
271	const compareMs = performance.now() - start
272	
273	const report = {
274	  components_checker: totals.componentsChecker,
275	  components_matched: totals.componentsMatched,
276	  props_checker: totals.propsChecker,
277	  props_shared: totals.propsShared,
278	  props_missing: totals.propsMissing,
279	  props_collapsed: totals.propsCollapsed,
280	  verdicts: counts,
281	  distinct_comparisons: verdictCache.size,
282	  failed_exports: totals.failedExports,
283	  ambiguous_exports: totals.ambiguousExports,
284	  program_ms: Math.round(programMs),
285	  compare_ms: Math.round(compareMs),
286	  examples,
287	}
288	writeFileSync(args.out, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2))
289	if (args.dump) writeFileSync(args.dump, JSON.stringify(dumped))
290	if (args.rows) writeFileSync(args.rows, JSON.stringify(rows))
291	if (args.missing) writeFileSync(args.missing, JSON.stringify(missingDetails))
292	program.dispose()
293	api.close()
294	console.error(
295	  `${totals.componentsMatched}/${totals.componentsChecker} components, ${totals.propsShared} shared props, ` +
296	    `${verdictCache.size} distinct comparisons, program ${(programMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s, ` +
297	    `compare ${(compareMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`,
298	)
